title: Poverty Measurement in India: Historical & Post-Independent Committees
summary: Poverty estimation in India evolved from Dadabhai Naoroji's jail cost of living to official calorie intake and state-specific CPI consumption baskets.

blocks.title: First-Principles Core Truth
blocks.summary: Poverty estimation in India evolved from Dadabhai Naoroji's jail cost of living to official calorie intake and state-specific CPI consumption baskets.

blocks.content: 🗺️ Chronological Evolution of Indian Poverty Line Committees
1. Pre-Independence (Dadabhai Naoroji, 1867): *Poverty and Un-British Rule in India*. First estimate based on **Jail Cost of Living** (₹16 to ₹35 per head per year).
2. Y.K. Alagh Task Force (1979): Defined official poverty line strictly on **Calorie Intake**: **2400 kcal/day (Rural)** and **2100 kcal/day (Urban)**.
3. D.T. Lakdawala Committee (1993): Retained 2400/2100 kcal criteria. Disaggregated national poverty into **State-Specific Poverty Lines** using CPI-AL (Rural) and CPI-IW (Urban).
4. Planning Commission Framework: Used NSSO 5-yearly Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (MPCE - Monthly Per Capita Consumption Expenditure).

blocks.text:
⚡ 1. Historical Timeline of Indian Poverty Committees
- **Dadabhai Naoroji (1867–70):** Used Jail Cost of Living for adults ($ rac{2}{3}$ of population needing full diet, children $ rac{1}{3}$ needing half diet $implies  rac{3}{4}$ average adult jail diet).
- **National Planning Committee (1938):** Chaired by Jawaharlal Nehru (initiated by Subhash Chandra Bose). Set poverty line at ₹15 to ₹20 per capita per month.
- **Bombay Plan (1944):** Proposed a poverty line of ₹75 per capita per year.
- **Planning Commission Working Group (1962):** Recommended national minimum consumption of ₹20/month (Rural) and ₹25/month (Urban).

📖 2. Post-Independence Official Committees Matrix
| Committee & Year | Primary Benchmark Criteria | Inflation Index Used | Key Innovation / Policy Feature |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Y.K. Alagh Task Force (1979)** | **Calorie Intake:**
Rural = **2400 kcal/day**
Urban = **2100 kcal/day** | Fixed monetary equivalent based on 1973-74 prices | First official quantitative calorie-based national poverty line |
| **D.T. Lakdawala Committee (1993)** | Retained Alagh 2400/2100 kcal calorie benchmarks | **CPI-AL** (Consumer Price Index for Agricultural Laborers) for Rural;
**CPI-IW** (Industrial Workers) for Urban | **Created State-Specific Poverty Lines** to account for interstate price variation; eliminated uniform national line |

🏛️ 3. Why Rural Calorie Requirement (2400 kcal) > Urban (2100 kcal)
Rural population engages in heavier manual agricultural physical labor, requiring higher daily caloric expenditure than urban service/industrial workers.

⚖️ 4. Common Prelims & Mains Traps
- ⚠️ **Exam Trap 1:** Lakdawala Committee did NOT abandon the Alagh calorie criteria; it retained 2400/2100 kcal, but updated price indexation using **CPI-AL and CPI-IW**.
- ⚠️ **Exam Trap 2:** Dadabhai Naoroji's Jail Cost of Living estimate applied a $ rac{3}{4}$ multiplier to adult jail diet to adjust for child demographic proportions in society.

blocks.content:
#### Tier 1 — Recall MCQ
**Q:** Which committee first introduced state-specific poverty lines updated via CPI-AL (Agricultural Laborers) and CPI-IW (Industrial Workers)?  
(A) Y.K. Alagh Task Force (1979)  
(B) D.T. Lakdawala Committee (1993)  
(C) Suresh Tendulkar Committee (2009)  
(D) C. Rangarajan Committee (2014)  
**Answer: — Lakdawala Committee introduced state-level price disaggregation using CPI-AL and CPI-IW.

#### Tier 2 — Applied Scenario
**Scenario:** A researcher evaluates 1995 poverty data using a single uniform national monetary line across all Indian states. Identify the methodological flaw corrected by the Lakdawala Committee.  
**Resolution:** The researcher ignores interstate price variation. Lakdawala showed that living costs differ across states, necessitating state-specific CPI-adjusted poverty lines.

#### Tier 3 — Mains Descriptive Prompt
*'Trace the evolution of poverty estimation in India from Dadabhai Naoroji's Jail Cost of Living to the Lakdawala Committee. What were the structural limitations of calorie-anchored poverty lines?'*
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Master the distinctions between monetary policy tools (Repo vs Reverse Repo, MSF, SDF) and fiscal deficit calculation formulas.
